entity.label: Southern East Madagascar Current
entity.identity_scope_note: Southward East Madagascar Current along southeast Madagascar. This proposal resolves the southern branch explicitly; it does not include the northward branch, underlying equatorward East Madagascar Undercurrent, offshore South Indian Ocean Countercurrent, or downstream eddies.

identity_evidence.source_locator: Title; Introduction paragraph2; abstract; Results3.1 paragraph17
identity_evidence.decision: The primary text explicitly identifies a southward East Madagascar Current. The southern qualifier distinguishes the named poleward branch from northward flow, the underlying equatorward undercurrent and offshore countercurrent.
identity_evidence.classification_basis: Introduction identifies the western boundary current of the South Indian subtropical gyre. Abstract describes near-surface expression and1992–2005 altimetry with eddy and interannual variability.

records.support: Southward branch from approximately20S to Cap Sainte Marie at approximately25deg30minS. Source cites Duncan1970 and Lutjeharms1988b; this is a contextual literature estimate, not a new length measured by the2001 cruise.

SectionsT5–T8 in April2001 off southeast Madagascar. Near-surface current structure uses VMADCP mean velocity in the upper100m. Numeric edge cutoff, boundary coordinates and width uncertainty are not specified in this passage.

source_dimensions.interpretation: Separate source-reported dimensions, not the sides of a current footprint. April2001 width and contextual branch length must not be multiplied into an area. No seasonal range, dated axis, fixed width layer or annual mean inferred.
